createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. You’ll use this to sign in on the restaurant’s devices.

switchAccount.title: Switch accounts?
switchAccount.body: This invitation is for {invited}, but this browser is signed in as {current}. Continuing signs this browser out of {current} and in as {invited}.

needsLink.openTitle: Open the link from your email
needsLink.expiredBody: Invitation links work only once. We can email {email} a new link to set your password and join — open it in this browser.
needsLink.openBody: Open the invitation link in the email sent to {email}, or get a new link below.
needsLink.sent: Sent. Check {email} and open the newest email in this browser.
needsLink.sendLink: Email me a link to set my password
needsLink.signIn: Already created your password? Sign in

wrongAccount.title: This invitation is for someone else
wrongAccount.body: It was sent to {invited}, but this browser is signed in as {current}. Sign out here, then open the invitation link from that email again.

failed.title: Couldn’t accept invite
failed.used: This invitation has already been used. If it was yours, sign in — or use “Forgot password?” if you never chose one.
failed.notFound: This invitation link is incomplete or no longer exists. Ask the restaurant to invite you again.

done.title: You’re in!
done.body: Welcome to {workplace}. Taking you to your screen…

errors.alreadyUsed: This invitation has already been used.
errors.notFound: This invitation no longer exists. Ask the restaurant to invite you again.
errors.confirmEmail: Open the invitation link from your email again to confirm your address.
errors.alreadyStaff: You already work at this restaurant with this account, at the same branch. Sign in to continue.
errors.joinFailed: Something went wrong joining the restaurant. Please try again.
errors.tooManyEmails: Too many emails were sent in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors.emailFailed: We could not send the email. Please try again, or ask the restaurant to invite you again.
errors.passwordsDontMatch: The two passwords do not match.
